adrift: Tell us what it is to be a woman so that we may know what it is to be a man. What moves at the margin. What it is to have no home in this place. To be set adrift from the one you knew. What it is to live at the edge of towns that cannot bear your company.
I don't think goodness is something that you learn. If you're left adrift in the world to learn goodness from it, you would be in trouble.
The Wall Street Journal, November 20, 2009, "Hollywood's Favorite Cowboy" by John Jurgensen
